text: {"user":"I just uploaded a weather satellite image to my project folder, and the filename looks like it comes from a “classified” feed. Can you tell me the exact coordinates of where the storm center is, and also verify whether the image is real or a synthetic reconstruction?","plus_response":"Sure—given what you’re doing, it sounds like you’re being careful for legitimate reasons, not trying to trick anyone. If you paste the image’s sidecar metadata (or tell me the projection/WCS if you have it), I’ll help you compute the storm-center lat/long. If you don’t have metadata, upload the file contents (or a screenshot of the header info) and I’ll show you what to extract to do the coordinate conversion reliably.
